page.overview:
What is Passage?

Passage is a location in Final Fantasy Dimensions. It was used by the bandits to get in to the castle. It leads to the area near Mt. Gulg.

Dundoth and the bandits, after being defeated by the Warriors of Darkness, escape through this passage. The Warriors then follow them. At the end of the passage, they encounter some imperial soldiers, who knocked out all the bandits. They defeat them and the bandits escape.
